correctness.rationale: The representation-theoretic reduction and sharp norm estimate were independently reconstructed. After the Hodge/determinant identification the summand is the adjoint image under \(L(X)\) on \(\wedge^2V\), with Hilbert--Schmidt scaling \(n-2\). The product-vector projection formula reduces the maximum Schmidt coefficient to the traceless one-body transition matrix. In skew-normal form the package sum-of-squares identity proves \(\lVert BA^*\rVert_{HS}^2\le 1+|\langle a,b\rangle|^2\), hence the normalized maximum is \(2/n\). Equality forces a Slater two-form and therefore \(X=P-(2/n)I\); the coherent root vector has normalized largest squared singular value \(1/(n-2)\). Independent random matrix checks for dimensions five through seven stayed below the sharp value and the rank-two projection family attained it exactly.
